[*] Fixed: Old map was displayed in the Region Selection screen at the start of the game.

[/list]
 

[h3]Known bugs[/h3]

[list]
[*] Technical text in Tutorial Quest Descriptions in some languages.

[*] No player feedback on why some answers are locked when talking to Gang Leaders.
[*] New Capo displays the same status he had when he was a lieutenant.
[*] in the “That Sinking Feeling” campaign, certain characters are accessible through the Lieutenant Menu when they shouldn’t be.
[*] Lieutenant remains inaccessible in a nearby City if the aerodrome was destroyed before he arrived there.
[*] Lieutenants don’t always choose the fastest routes to get to a location.
[*] Players can research bonuses that aren’t in the Research Tree. Spooky...
[*] Incorrect portrait displayed in some dialogues. 
[*] The Casino isn’t specified as a Loyalty building in city building filters.

notes.title: Cartel Tycoon 1.0 // Devlog 21
notes.content:
[h2]Hola Capos![/h2] 

[h3]Tons of new features,  hundreds of Quality of Life changes, and reworks are packed in Cartel Tycoon 1.0! Learn more about them in this devlog! [/h3]

[previewyoutube=AWnCz4aMg0w;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Prefer the written word? We've got you covered. 
The full transcript is available below:[/h3]

July 26  is right around the corner. This is it, huh? After 3 years of development, we have finally reached the full release of Cartel Tycoon. Well, almost. Once again, my name is Andrey, and I’m the community manager of Cartel Tycoon. Welcome to Devlog 21, and welcome to Cartel Tycoon 1.0. Let’s begin. 

Today I will tell you all about what’s coming to Cartel Tycoon with the 1.0 Release. There’s a lot to cover so let’s get down to business. But if you want to take a trip down memory lane first - you can find the post titled “Road from Early Access to 1.0” on all our socials.


1.0 Release is full of new features - some of them our community on Discord has been testing since Spring, and some of them will be new for everyone. First of all, fully functioning Special Buildings with lots of unique features - Prison, Airport, Military Base, Guerilla Camp, and Indigenous Territory are in the game. They’ve been developed with your needs, feedback, and wants in mind, and they are useful from the early game to the end game, changing the balance of the regions quite drastically. If you want to know more about them - check out this Devlog right here. 

[previewyoutube=XuNcieCfP7Y;full][/previewyoutube]

Another feature that changes the balance are Enemy Gangs.  They know have faces, needs, fears, and personalities, and their actions are affected by yours. We have a special devlog about Gangs too, check it out right here. 

[previewyoutube=jutkPIAF3Ts;full][/previewyoutube]

A new drug is also coming to the game - Heroin. It’s one of the most difficult to produce, but it also brings the most money. The introduction of heroin overhauls the end game and gives a new purpose to the starting drug - Opium, which wasn’t very useful after the first few hours of the gameplay before. Along with a new illegal product, we’re bringing two new legal ones that you can grow - Avocado and Quinoa, which are quite expensive on their own - new contenders for your family-friendly empire, but also offer more variety in packaging for your sneaky needs! 


Also, we’re introducing a new building called the Food Factory - it can produce dog food and sauces, so now you have another option of producing legal products - not only growing or buying! 


As for more QoL changes, we’ve made a new filter called “Resource Finder” - you can use it to check what product is located where on a grand scale. This feature will help locate not only products but Dirty Money too - no more searching through your property for cash - just click a button and see where it is!


We’ve also got another major rework - Global Unlocks. We’ve been tweaking the system for a while now, to make the process more natural, reworking the objectives players needed to complete. But there was still a major problem - River Piers. Completing the “That Sinking Feeling” campaign and getting that sweet-sweet [REDACTED] as a reward is pretty good, but locking players out of the upgrades if they don’t want to play Story Mode - is not. River Pier upgrades will be open to everyone, but those who complete the campaign will still get that sweet-sweet [REDACTED], as a skin for River Pier III.


Another important feature coming with 1.0 is Steam Cloud Saves! Yay, now you don’t have to keep your save files on you every time you want to play Cartel Tycoon away from your PC - they’re in the clouds now! 


Also, our awesome artists from around the globe have been working on the new OST for the game! We’ve got lots of new songs from the artists we’ve worked with in Early Access, and from the new ones - who joined us in the Full Release. For example, this song right now!

And, of course, what’s a full release of the game without achievements! We’ve got easy ones, we’ve got hard ones, we’ve got funny ones - we’ve got them all. Completionists, rejoice! You now can 100% Cartel Tycoon! 


As always, we’ve got a lot of smaller changes we’ll be bringing to the game. For example, we’ve improved our transportation logic a bit, so your trucks will be using their full potential when delivering goods! Many more changes are coming, and we’ll share them in the Patch Notes! 


We also wanted to thank those of you, who’ve been with us since the Early Access, so if you own Cartel Tycoon already, you’ll be getting special cartel emblems to use in-game. Everyone who got the game in Early Access and made their tinyBuild account will get them, so if you don’t have the game yet, you can get them too if you purchase the game before the 1.0 hits! 


All of us in Moon Moose would like to, once again, thank all of you for being on this journey with us. Cartel Tycoon wouldn’t be what it is today without your feedback, thoughts, and suggestions.


Cartel Tycoon releases on July 26, and we’re so happy to finally be here. But the work doesn’t stop - we’re working on optimizing the game, making it even more beautiful and polished to provide you with the 1.0 Release we can truly call 1.0! 

We’re Moon Moose and we thank you for believing in us. See you on July 26, Capos. Goodbye. 


[list]

[*] [url=https://twitter.com/CartelTycoon]Twitter[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.facebook.com/CartelTycoon/]Facebook[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.instagram.com/carteltycoon/]Instagram[/url]
[/list]

notes.title: Road from Early Access to 1.0
notes.content:
[h3]So this is it. The moment we’ve all been waiting for. Cartel Tycoon is leaving Early Access in just a couple of days. It’s been a long journey, and today we wanted to reminisce a bit with all of you. 

Gather ‘round, Capos… And let’s get back to the beginning…. [/h3]

 
[h2][b]2019[/b][/h2]
Some of you probably think that the game was revealed in 2021, but this is not the case. First, we introduced the game long before that - in 2019.
[previewyoutube=nza6AOv4oyc;full][/previewyoutube]

It was pretty bare-bones at this point, but the idea for it all was already in place, and development was in full motion.

[h2][b]2020[/b][/h2]
And in 2020 [b]we have released our Demo on Steam[/b], and already found some of our awesome audience. The Demo became Survival Mode, by the way, which was our main focus in the early stages of development!
[previewyoutube=45_yFrItWx8;full][/previewyoutube]

And after the demo, on [b]October 29 of 2020, came the Uncut Earliest Access[/b]… As you might’ve guessed from the title - it was a very early version of the game, which we provided to the supporters through our website before our game hit major marketplaces like Steam. We wanted to start working with the community at the earliest possible time!
[previewyoutube=iqUYZvpibeg;full][/previewyoutube]

And a couple of months, after that, in [b]December of 2020[/b] we released our first update - the Dirty Money update. Yep, our earliest version didn’t have one of the now core mechanics of the game! This update also introduced the allegiance of our lieutenants and their rogue behavior! 
[previewyoutube=T7CbkV3rLKQ;full][/previewyoutube]

We’ve started working on bringing even more systems to the game, patching things out, and working closely with the feedback of our earliest supporters… and we had a Steam release date! 

[h2][b]2021[/b][/h2]
Cartel Tycoon hit the shelves of Steam and other digital markets on March 18 of 2021. What a lovely day it has been! With this update, we’ve introduced the “Needs and Fears” story, our first version of the Tutorial, and unique lieutenant quests. 
[previewyoutube=BxgCE5DWH5s;full][/previewyoutube]

After that, we’ve started releasing a major update to the game each couple of months - each one built on the feedback we’ve received and, of course, experimentation. With each update, Cartel Tycoon got bigger and better (for the most part, we’ve reversed some things, of course, that’s the beauty of developing the game closely with the community), and we didn’t want to stop. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36613041/64ace58df03e4d2f9fa890b7aa883e5237839aa6.gif[/img]

A lot of the systems we’ve introduced weren’t planned from the start, and the game now is quite different from what we’ve envisioned - and that’s a good thing. Because we’ve got a lot of supporters who want the game to succeed as much as we do, we want to once again thank all of them for their passion.  ːcartel_loveː
[previewyoutube=G87c_Lf3UMY;full][/previewyoutube]

At the end of 2021, we’ve started gearing up for the big thing - the 1.0 Release. We’ve decided that we’ll release the features we’re working on gradually through Betas, so our supporters can experience them before the full game hits the stores! 

[h2][b]2022[/b][/h2]
That’s what we did for the long-awaited [b]Special Buildings[/b] update! With the feedback and speculations from the community, we decided to expand the feature and make the buildings truly Special - with questlines and multiple functions. 
[previewyoutube=XuNcieCfP7Y;full][/previewyoutube]

And after that - [b]Enemy Gangs[/b], an addition that was directly inspired by our community suggestions. We wanted players to put a face to the grunts that try to take down their empires and introduce a system that allows players to choose more peaceful solutions to enemy problems and expand the gameplay loop that way.
[previewyoutube=jutkPIAF3Ts;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]And now, 5 days away, we have a full release ahead of us.[/b] Special Buildings and Enemy Gangs aren’t the only new thing coming - we’ve got a new type of drug, new building players can build, and new legal resources for those of you who want to play a more family-friendly type of game. New music! Balance changes! Smaller reworks! And Achievements! Everyone loves achievements!
[previewyoutube=XpQQTrwkiO4;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][b]Cartel Tycoon 1.0 hits the stores on July 26[/b]. Once again, this journey wouldn’t have been possible without your support. We’re so excited to be here, to finally give us our full 1.0 vision. And start working on future updates.

See you on the 1.0 side, Capos. We love you.

- Moon Moose & tinyBuild[/h3]

notes.title: Enemy Gangs // Devlog 20
notes.content:
[h2]Hola Capos![/h2] 

[h3]Enemy Gangs are coming to Cartel Tycoon on July 26!  Check out our newest devlog! [/h3]

[previewyoutube=jutkPIAF3Ts;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Prefer the written word? We've got you covered. 
The full transcript is available below:[/h3]

Hey everyone! It’s Andrey here - without a video today - but it’s still me! So, we’ve announced the date of 1.0… Cartel Tycoon will leave Early Access on July 26! Pretty exciting, huh? Today I wanted to focus on one of the features coming with the 1.0 Release - Enemy Gangs, their leaders, and how their introduction will change up the gameplay of Cartel Tycoon! Let’s go!
 
 
Some of you have been testing out Enemy Gangs in the Steam Beta, and we’ve gathered your awesome feedback for the 1.0 Release! Thank you for your help! And now, an introduction to Enemy Gangs for everyone else:
 
What started as an overhaul, became a completely new and enormous feature! Enemy Gangs are here, and you can do A LOT with them. They’re no longer just cars that periodically attack your property! They now have their own leaders, which you can talk to, do business with, and even acquire their territory not just through war but through D… Di… Dip… through Deep Peaceful Dialogues! By bringing more functions to Enemy Gangs we wanted to spice up the gameplay and give the players more strategy options they can choose in any phase of the game.

 
When you start a new game, enemy gangs won’t be very hostile. You’re a new kid on the block, after all! But your decisions will lead to either the expansion of your relationships with enemy gangs and their leaders or their crumbling demise. For example, seizing the enemy buildings will worsen your relationship with this particular gang, but killing an enemy gang boss will make all the other gangs fear and hate you and your cartel. After all, everyone has a piece of the pie, and they should stick with it, right? On contrary, if you start (and win) fights with government forces, enemy gangs will respect you more, because what can be nobler for a Capo?
 
But there are, of course, other ways that can affect your relationship with enemy gangs. You can also do that during your talks with Gang Leaders. Each Gang will have a unique Leader, and understanding them will offer you ways to strengthen your relationship. And not only can you trade snarky remarks in dialogues, but you can also trade goods (which will be quite helpful at the start of the game). We think that these changes will introduce more diversity to the gameplay, and we hope that you’ll love them.
 
But it’s not all fun, trades and games, of course. You’ll still be able to kill the opposing gangs and take all the regions under your command. But there’s more gameplay diversity on that front also. You can annihilate enemy gangs by capturing their cities and killing their leaders or… you can kill them with kindness. Well, not kindness, but empathy and wits. If your relationship with the Gang Leader is good enough he might consider joining you in your crusade! You can just hire him as your lieutenant (of course, if your Cartel is full, someone will need to go, but oh well, what can you do), and leave the city and its mayor for the taking.
 
After the Beta we’ve tweaked some of these systems and made some new things - Gangs will now attack players who dared to step on the enemy soil and take their buildings. We’ve also made Gang Settings for the Sandbox Mode, so you can play around with their aggressiveness and power. And don’t you worry, we’re working on even more ways of interacting with Enemy Gangs using your feedback!

 
There are, of course, more complex system changes coming along with Enemy Gangs introduction, but this devlog would turn into a full-motion picture if I list all of them. I hope that all of you are as excited as we are for these upcoming changes!

 
Another Devlog about the 1.0 Release is coming, so stay tuned for that! We’ll talk about more changes, reworks, and even rewards!
We’re nearing the 1.0 Release, and all of us in Moon Moose would like to, once again, thank all of you for being on this journey with us. Cartel Tycoon wouldn’t be what it is today without your feedback, thoughts and suggestions.


As always, write your impressions in the comments, and don’t forget to subscribe here, on YouTube, and on our socials! Share your thoughts about the game we’re building together!

[*] [url=https://www.facebook.com/CartelTycoon/]Facebook[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.instagram.com/carteltycoon/]Instagram[/url]
[/list]

notes.title: Cartel Tycoon 1.0 is coming on July 26!
notes.content:
[h2]Hola Capos! 

No beating around the bush, [b]Cartel Tycoon will leave Early Access on July 26[/b]. We’re so excited to finally present you the 1.0 Version of the game in just a couple of weeks. [/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1220140/Cartel_Tycoon/

[h2]Check out the Live-Action Trailer right now! [/h2]

[previewyoutube=XpQQTrwkiO4;full][/previewyoutube]

The 1.0 release is full of long-awaited features like [b]Special Buildings, Enemy Gangs, the ability to make Heroin, Steam Achievements, and Cloud Saves[/b]. We’ve made the game better in every way, optimized, reworked, and polished every nook and cranny, so we’re finally ready to leave Early Access.

But what does leaving Early Access mean exactly? Well, it means that we’ve done (almost) everything we wanted with the game initially and finished our Early Access Roadmap. That doesn’t mean the development is stopping, no! We will be constantly supporting the game after the 1.0 release and will be working on improving it even further. But that’s a whole talk for another time.  

We’ll talk about what’s coming to the game in an upcoming devlog. and we’ll share the Patch Notes with you as always.

We wanted to thank those who supported us during the EA life of the game, so [b]everyone who got Cartel Tycoon before the 1.0 will receive special Cartel Emblems[/b]! To get them you need to own the game and register your tinyBuild account before July 26. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36613041/2ca5e7d91dfc53c6af34efdfda8b9ece22267e0d.png[/img]

We’ve already updated the game to include them, so you can download the latest build and claim your rewards in the tinyBuild launcher!

And another thing - the price of Cartel Tycoon will remain the same on the 1.0 Release, but it will slightly go up in a couple of weeks, so [b]you’ll have the perfect opportunity to buy the 1.0 Release with the Early Access price for a limited time! [/b]

[h3]Thank you from the bottom of our hearts for being with us, and helping us on this journey, and we can’t wait for you Capos - both new and old - to experience the 1.0 version of Cartel Tycoon on July 26. 

We’ll be posting more updates in the coming days and weeks, so make sure to look out for them! See you on July 26! 

- Moon Moose [/h3]

Keep an eye on our social channels for all the latest news and updates, and be sure to [url=https://discord.gg/Cf674c8b]join the official Cartel Tycoon Discord[/url] to join the community, share your feedback, and chat with the development team.

[*] Fixed: Quest “When The Party’s Over” didn’t count the buildings that were built before the quest started. (Xellos)
[*] Fixed: Quest-Event "Research And Development" didn’t count the construction of Tier III buildings. (Xellos)
[*] Fixed: Incorrect quantity of Cocaine is displayed in the “Expectancy Theory” Quest dialogue (AlekcZX)
[*] Fixed: Product price doesn’t change after certain bonuses. (AlekcZX)
[*] Fixed: Government forces bug out if you save during the Terror Star activation (MazzoPowah)
[*] Fixed: Capo gets lost and stuck on isolated roads. We saved him! (Rackbox)
[*] Fixed: Using your Capos "Make a Deal" Ability starts a dialogue with no character portrait… Spooky! (Mr. Noodle)
[*] Fixed: After loading a save, progress in “Cash is King” Quest resets (Zipprian)
[*] Fixed: Transport Company II with bonuses was better than Transport Company III with bonuses (syra10)
[/list]

[/list]

notes.title: Join the Beta for the Special Buildings!
notes.content:
[h3]Hola everyone! 

[b]We've started a playtest of the Special Buildings[/b], and all of you are invited! [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36613041/5d647835430e75c75961f27fe3ad4038aa075cd5.png[/img]

Special Buildings are finally here - and lots of reworks, changes, and fixes to multiple systems to boot! We’ve got Loyalty Rework, we’ve got another Global Unlocks Rework, we’ve got Mayor Quests rework, and a lot more. It’s one of the most packed releases we’ve had!


[h3]IMPORTANT:
[list]
[*] Your old save won't work with the Beta! 
[*] Play on the English version of the game, localization is not finished yet! 
[/list][/h3]

But enough talk - let’s play! 

[h2]THE CODE FOR THE STEAM BETA IS: [b]CartelTycoonApril2022[/b] [/h2]


[h3]Join our Discord to talk to us directly about the Beta Update! [/h3]
[url=https://discord.gg/carteltycoon][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36613041/5078c48aabfb5234678c5d830b089d718379c0dd.png[/img][/url]

[h3]Beta Patch Notes are available below: [/h3]

[h3][b]Major changes[/b][/h3]

ːcartel_loveː[b]Special Buildings are in the game[/b]: Prison, Airport, Reservation, Guerillas, and Military Base have been activated, and now you can use them! Each Building introduces new quests, new mechanics, and unique characters!

ːcartel_loveː[b]Loyalty Rework[/b]: Bonuses added to Loyalty Scale. Loyalty now lowers with time, if it reaches zero - your Capo will die! Each playthrough starts with a positive Loyalty level. Loyalty level affects Allegiance. 

ːcartel_loveː[b]Unique Mayor Quests[/b]: Each city now has a pool of unique quests.

ːcartel_loveː[b]Global Unlocks Rework[/b]: Now any Lieutenant that becomes a Capo in your game will become a Starting Capo. We’ve also changed unlock conditions for Collectors Residence, it’s not tied to the Story Mode anymore!

ːcartel_loveː[b]Multiple changes to the region visuals[/b]. Now Neutral and Enemy Regions have different colors and look prettier than ever.

[h3]Other updates & changes[/h3]

[list]
[*] Removed the Terror requirements when hiring Lieutenants.
[*] 10 New Lieutenants are added to the game. 
[*] Your Lieutenants' Allegiance is now tied to the Loyalty level - If Loyalty is at maximum, their Allegiance will rise. 
[*] New Lieutenants become available for hire with no cool-downs if your Loyalty has reached its maximum.
[*] Reservation has a subregion that is initially locked for player construction. 
[*] Added a Lieutenant Ability “Peace Maker” - Loyalty slightly rises when the Lieutenant with this Ability is in the city. 
[*] When Capo crosses a police cordon, the player is presented with a choice to bribe the Police to let him through.
[*] The Quest-Events are presented not only with a marker but in the Phone Menu too for easier navigation
[*] Added 10+ new Quest-Events
[*] Reworked Mayor Quest-Event that involved hiring lieutenants - player now can choose whatever lieutenant he wants. 
[*] You can return money to Mayors or journalists at any time using their Quest-Event markers.
[*] Text about Capo’s death is now displayed in the Cartel WIndow. It’s only displayed with the first Capo death in the Cartel.
[*] Messages in the Event Log now disappear faster.
[*] Change starting dates in different Modes. 
[*] You can now exit the Lieutenant profile with an [X] button.
[/list]

[h3]Balance [/h3]

[list]
[*] Improved Research Tree progression between different Tiers of buildings. 
[*] Added additional cars to all the tiers of Residencies.
[*] More storage is added with Farms and Plantations upgrades.
[*] Added slots upgrades for Aerodromes instead of delivery time upgrades. 
[*] Bonuses for Seaport, Checkpoint and River Pier added to Research Tree.
[*] Changed progression values for Seaport, Checkpoint, and River Pier upgrades. 
[*] Area Depo now costs less.
[*] Increased cooldown for “Assassination” Ability.
[*] Lieutenants now move Precursor, Methylamine, Hydrochloric Acid in the same capacity as the Warehouse vehicles. (S, M, L)
[*] Loyalty Increases when Mayor debts are paid and journalists are bribed.
[*] Money players need to return to Mayors increases with each Mayor Favor. 
[/list]

[h3]Visual[/h3]

[list]
[*] Updated visuals for all tiers of Villages.
[*] Updated visuals and animations for Special Buildings.
[*] Updated animations for each Lab Tier.
[*] Updated visual for City Church.
[*] Updated mesh and visuals for Military Trucks and DEA cars.
[*] Updated visuals for Research Tree upgrades displayed on the buildings. 
[*] Updated visuals for US Army attack circle. 
[*] Updated visuals for different stages (active/inactive) of Lieutenant Abilities.  
[*] All the City buildings in the same city are now displayed on the same tab of the Building Menu.
[*] Added animation to display that new lieutenants are available for hire.
[*] Updated visual for Research Tree.
[*] New animations were added for Plantation III.
[*] New animations are displayed when taking control of the city, enemy buildings, or a Special Building.
[*] The amount of money the player is taking is now displayed in the Mayor Favor description.
[*] The price of the research is now displayed on the “Research” button in Research Tree.
[*] Updated visuals for Dryer.
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed: Incorrect boat animations for River Pier II.
[*] Dealer ability now increases the price only in the Smuggling Point the Lieutenant with the ability is at.
[*] Federales now only arrest buildings with illegal goods. 
[*] Fixed: Incorrect description for the Researcher Ability.
[*] Players are given fines if they ignore Quest-Events.
[*] Fixed: Incorrect product prices are displayed in Event Log and Market after failing a Quest-Event.
[*] The “CONTROL III” Quest now works correctly in the “Needs and Fears” campaign.
[*] Fixed: Lieutenants Mateo Pinzon and Paulina Hernandes weren’t available for hire in Sandbox and the “That Sinking Feeling” campaign
[*] The button for Mayor Favor “Money Favor” wasn’t mapped correctly.
[*] Multiple Localization fixes.
[*] Multiple grammatical fixes in certain Quests.
[*] Players can now refuse the “Spot Check” Quest-Event.
[*] Mayor Favor “Release All” now increases in price after each use.
[*] Lieutenant Abilities “Robbery”, “Kidnapping” and “Concert” can now be canceled with a button.
[*] Added objective to speak with Diana after failing the quest “A Fair Exchange I” in the “That Sinking Feeling” campaign
[*] Fixed: Dirty Money wasn’t given to the player after successfully completing a Quest-Event if the Lieutenant was on the road. 
[*] Fixed: Free Labs and Dryers couldn’t be constructed if the player didn’t have enough money.
[*] US Army no longer attacks the Cartel if the Capo is changed.
[*] Fixed: US Army attacks Diana on River Pier multiple times after successful capture.
[*] Fixed: Sound effects don’t play in the Transition Screen after Capo’s death.
[*] Fixed: During the “Industrial Action” event Lieutenant upkeep rise is not displayed.
[/list]

[h3]Known bugs[/h3]

[list]
[*] The “Infamous” Ability isn’t displayed when choosing a Capo for Sandbox or Survival Mode.
[*] Researcher Ability doesn’t show visual feedback in the Research Center.
[*] Police icons disappear after loading the game in some instances.
[*] Lieutenants with Coordinator Ability sometimes start attacking buildings in their range when performing a different task.
[*] Double attack power is displayed when Lieutenants with Coordinator Ability is moved between buildings in his ability radius.
[*] Manual Icon keeps flashing after you load a Save Game.
[*] Capo selection screen in Sandbox and Survival Modes doesn’t display negative abilities.
[*] Incorrect visuals after Plantation III blows up.
[*] Can’t deselect highlighted Lieutenants using Ctrl + Click.
[*] An incorrect tip is displayed in Lieutenant Profile when he doesn’t have enough XP for promotion.
[*] War with US Army Progress Bar is displayed below other UI elements.
[*] Products and Money are not confiscated when an Enemy Gang captures your building.
[*] WASD Navigation doesn’t work in Research Tree Menu.
[*] An incorrect tip is displayed when building a Chemical Factory.
[*] After loading a save progress in "Cash is king" Quest is reset.
[*] Incorrect plane animations in Airports.
[*] The Workshop description in Research Center doesn’t contain a list of products that can be packaged.
[*] Incorrect visuals are displayed when a building is overflowed with products.
[*] Incorrect Ability visuals on Area Depo.
[/list]

notes.title: Special Buildings // Devlog 19
notes.content:
[h2]Hola Capos![/h2] 

[h3]We're finally ready to talk about Special Buildings in detail. Check out our newest devlog! [/h3]

[previewyoutube=XuNcieCfP7Y;full][/previewyoutube]


[h3]Prefer the written word? We've got you covered. 
The full transcript is available below:[/h3]

Welcome to the first devlog of 2022, everyone! It’s Andrey, and I’m here to tell you all about the Special Buildings, that are coming to the game in the next update. For real. We’ve been working on them for the past year, and are excited to finally reveal their functions and make them come alive on your maps. Without further ado, let’s get right into it. 

There are 5 Special Buildings in the game: Prison, Airport, Guerillas, Reservation, and Military Base. All of them will have distinct functions, and to unlock their full potential, you’ll need to conquer the Region the buildings are in and improve your relationship with the ones in charge. Let’s talk about the unique aspects of every building right now. 

Take Prison, for example. It drastically changes your relationship with your lieutenants. They no longer die, when they’re found by Federales or DEA or cross the Police roadblock - they go to Prison! What that means, that they are no longer a part of your Cartel, but you can complete certain quests to choose their fate: for example, you may orchestrate a prison breakout, and get your lieutenant back for free. You can also talk to the Warden to buy out your lieutenants before their term ends. Or… dispose of them without any unwanted noise. What happens in Prison doesn’t always stay in Prison, but you can always pay to cover your tracks. Prison also doubles as a new Recruitment Area - you can check out who’s staying inside, and bring the best ones to your Cartel. But now let’s talk about the people you can’t control… 


Moving on to Guereilas! This building holds a lot of potential for those who don’t always choose the fights they can win. At first glance, you might think that it’s just another smuggling point, but it’s so much more than that. Yes, it’s a smuggling point that you can use to sell your illegal goods and not worry about Police, Federales, and DEA interference. But if you become friends with the Guerrillas, they’ll help you win your wars… if they’re in the mood, of course! They’ll defend your cities and production chains not only from the enemy gangs but from officers of all calibers as well. And they’ll attack enemy territories with your lieutenants! You can't control where they go, and they sometimes need the rest, of course, so they won’t be able to help if you start wars again and again all over the place, but their power is yours if you know when to pick a fight. 


And you certainly don't want to pick a fight with the Military. Let’s talk about Military Base. This Special Building lets you upgrade the defense of your production chain with military technology. Who doesn’t want a building that can defend itself against the attackers? And that’s not all - if you’re good friends with the General and you supply him with his favorite white powder (hint: he’s NOT a baker) without missing deliveries, he will be too busy to attack you if you reach his Attention Star on the Terror scale. And your lieutenants can use Military Base to become more powerful for a limited time - partying with the General gives you lots of benefits! 


But a good Capo doesn’t always party, good Capo doesn’t only work for himself but for the people of all the Regions he liberates! Or something like that, I guess. You don’t need to believe this story but the people in the Reservation do. Reservation is similar to Villages in its purpose, but it works in a different way. It operates on Loyalty, not upgrades. You can buy legal and illegal goods here, and the higher your loyalty, the more things you can buy - including unique legal goods that sell for quite a price. We wanted to expand our Loyalty mechanic that didn’t have a lot of ways to be used in-game, so that’s where the Reservation came in. We think it’s a great incentive for players to try out new ways of playing and benefit from it! And benefit you will - when you’re not friendly with the Reservation, they won’t let you use most of the land in Amado! Something about it being holy or whatever… Sometimes you just want to fly away from it all! And we’ve got a solution just for you… 
 

And, finally, Airport! We think some of your lieutenants could use a vacation, eh? Of course, who travels without baggage, right? You can send your lieutenants on a trip, and give them some… souvenirs to deliver.  Lieutenants won’t be available when they’re away but will return happy and with plenty of cash for your Empire. Boarding starts on schedule, so don’t let them miss their flight! Or just go and do everything yourself, and have a little break to boot. The Airport has a lot of slots for lieutenants so it will be very helpful at the start of the game. 


Each Special Building will open new opportunities and benefits when you establish a relationship with those in charge. We’re so happy to finally bring you Special Buildings, new characters and to expand Cartel Tycoon even further! We’ve got more plans for Special Buildings down the line, and are looking forward to your feedback when they update drops.


Are you excited to play the new update of Cartel Tycoon? Write your impressions in the comments, and don’t forget to subscribe here, on YouTube, and on our socials! Share your thoughts about the game we’re building together!




[list]
[*] [url=https://discord.gg/CartelTycoon]Discord[/url]
[*] [url=https://twitter.com/CartelTycoon]Twitter[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.facebook.com/CartelTycoon/]Facebook[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.instagram.com/carteltycoon/]Instagram[/url]
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36613041/da321ce920ae55535ce277b12daabc1af606e792.png[/img]

[h3]Hola Capos![/h3]
 
[h3]Today we want to talk a bit about our plans for Cartel Tycoon in 2022. [/h3]
 
[b]In the coming weeks, we want to release our Special Building Update![/b] We talked about them a lot and will be releasing a full devlog, so we don’t want to spend too much time on it in this post. The gist of it is - Prison, Guerillas, Reservation, Airport, and Military Base are finally coming to the game! We believe that their release will significantly shake up the meta, because each of them offers unique enchantments to your Cartel, and we can’t wait for you to try them out! They are the main attraction of this update, of course, but we’ll also be delivering multiple reworks of already existing systems, lots of improvements, balance changes, and bug fixes! 
 
But the big event of this year, of course, is our [b]full release[/b]! And… [b]we’re aiming to release the game this Spring/Summer season![/b]
 
We will bring even more variety to the game, and after listening closely to your feedback all the time we were in Early Access, we want to introduce meaningful changes to already existing systems, so the game can be the best version of itself when it’s fully out and ready.
 
For example, we heard your feedback to [b]Global Unlocks[/b], and have been working hard on improving the system. We still want to keep these achievements in the game, but we realize that tying almost all of them to the Story Mode didn’t work, and you, as players, didn’t get that feeling of “Pride and Accomplishment” we wanted you to have. So we’ve been working on reimagining these challenges, so they can be obtainable through gameplay, and not just Story Mode grind. We hope that you’ll love the changes we’re making.
The second one is [b]Terror system[/b]. We introduced changes to it in the Balance Update but wanted to still keep the original hardcore vision, so now the behavior of the system is tied to Difficulty Levels!  If you want permanent stars and other hardcore Terror challenges, you can select the higher difficulty! And if you want more mild gameplay, you can choose an easier difficulty. Hardcore and mid-core gamers will be happy with that change! 
Of course, we’re also tweaking a lot of the other systems to make the game more stable and enjoyable for everyone! 
 
With all these changes coming to the game we have to [i][b]postpone the release of multiplayer[/b][/i].
[u][b]Our goal - first and foremost - is to make the game the best it can be on release[/b][/u], and we don’t want to cut corners to release it with more features but with less quality. That’s why we have decided to focus on providing the best Single-player experience on release, and continue our work on Multiplayer through 2022. 
 
But the Full Release will come with [b]tons of new content[/b] - we’re [u]expanding the enemy gangs[/u], and confrontations with them will offer players more choice, will provide more immersive storytelling to Cartel Tycoon, and will just be fun. Also, a dozen of new lieutenants, more music, [i][u]Steam Achievements[/u][/i], new drugs, and multiple expansions of already existing systems are coming!
 
[b]We’re fully committed to supporting the game after the release[/b], and will bring you A LOT more mechanics, stories, characters, and, most importantly, fun gameplay innovations! 
 
[b]We want to thank everyone who supported us during the Early Access period[/b] and those who supported us even before we were on Steam! Cartel Tycoon wouldn’t have been possible without all of you, and we believe we can do oh so much more! 
 
[h3]Have a good day, Capos, and see you soon! We’ve got an update to release, and a game to play. [/h3]


---------------------------------------------

Keep an eye on our social channels for all the latest news and updates, and be sure to [url=https://discord.gg/Cf674c8b]join the official Cartel Tycoon Discord[/url] to join the community, share your feedback, and chat with the development team.[/h3]

notes.title: Balance Update is LIVE
notes.content:
[h2]Hola, Capos! [/h2]

[h3]Our Balance Update is now live across all the platforms! The Update is out of the Beta, and in it, we have implemented a less punishing Terror system, reworked Attention Stars, gave your Lieutenants another useful function, and introduced many balance changes to the game that ultimately give you more choice in your playstyle! 

We'll continue working on further Balance changes and system reworks, and will have more for you in our next Major Update - Special Buildings!

As always, thank you for your support and we'll see you on the lands of Cartel Tycoon! [/h3]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36613041/dadf7ac8e9c5c331a16706099415acacb58a313e.png[/img]

[h3]Cartel Tycoon v 0.9.3.2610 (January Balance Update)[/h3]

[h2]Major changes[/h2]

ːcartel_loveː [b]Major Terror rework:[/b] We wanted to make Terror less punishing, and that’s why now Terror reduces over time by itself and Attention Stars deactivate after the attack. The Terror scale has been changed, and now gaining each new Attention Star will require more Terror. We’ve also added more ways to gain Terror to balance things out. We will continue working on the Terror system in future updates.

ːcartel_loveː [b]Major attacks rework:[/b] We’re also introducing changes to Attention Star attacks themselves: Order of Attention Stars has been changed. Now it’s: Police, Federales, DEA, National Army, CIA, US Army. New Attack type added for Police - Road Cordons which will block roads for a limited amount of time (don’t send your Lieutenants there), Federales now arrest buildings, DEA now searches multiple buildings, the “Investigation” attack has been removed. US Army follows your Lieutenants even if you move them.

ːcartel_loveː [b]Major Village rework:[/b] With this update, we wanted to make interactions with Villages more complex and fun: Villages are now upgradable, upgrades unlock new legal products. You are now able to choose the price for legal products in Villages. Buying for a higher price grants you more Loyalty, taking products for free rises your Terror. You can now use Dirty Money to buy products from villages.

ːcartel_loveː [b]Smuggling points rework:[/b] We wanted to make Smuggling Points more money-efficient and also introduce new ways to use your Lieutenants. The delivery time now also includes product loading time. Smuggling Points now have 1 Delivery Slot, each Lieutenant stationed in the Smuggling Point will grant an additional Delivery Slot. Each Smuggling point has a different amount of additional Delivery Slots. You can now sell illegal products without packaging in all Smuggling Points, but selling them this way through Seaports and Border Checkpoints will grant you, additional Terror. You can sell packed drugs in all the Smuggling Points also.

ːcartel_loveː Global Unlocks rework: All of the regions have been removed from Global Unlocks, you can use all of them in Sandbox and Survival Modes without additional unlocks now! Conditions for unlocking Pathos Residence were changed. Players who already unlocked it will keep it. We will continue to improve the Global Unlocks system in future updates. 

Quest-Events rework: We feel like Quest-Events brought more storytelling variety to the game, but also ːcartel_loveː brought more challenge, especially in the early game - we wanted to address it in this update. More Quest-Events were added, and now you’ll see more positive Quest-Events that will help you grow your Empire. Lieutenants Quest-Events appear more often now.

ːcartel_loveː [b]Lieutenants' experience no longer grows when they’re idle. [/b]Now If you want your Lieutenants to gain XP, you’ll have to use them!  

[h2]Balance[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]Market Balance has been changed:[/b] Base prices for Opium and Dried Cannabis have been lowered, their price on the Market will change more frequently but in a smaller range. Base prices for Meth and Cocaine have been increased, their price on the Market will change less frequently but in a larger range, The market also won’t affect Opium and Cannabis at the start of the game that much.
[*] Survival Mode balance has changed to reflect the current Balance changes.
[*] The Cannabis production Balance has been tweaked.
[*] Efficiency Layers have been changed across difficulty levels of Sandbox Mode.
[*] Difficulty levels for Sandbox have been changed: Easy now has 5 neutral regions, Normal has 3 neutral regions.
[*] The speed of cars on sand and gravel roads has been lowered, and the speed of cars on all the roads has been reworked.
[*] Prices of roads have been lowered.
[*] Prices and Upkeep Costs of these Tier I buildings in the Research Tree have been lowered: Farm, Warehouse, Transport Company, Workshop, River Pier.
[*] Prices of Passive Effects on Tier I of Research Tree have been lowered in half.
[*] Cities now lose control over the course of 16 days.
[*] Workshop Upgrades has been changed: drugs won’t need additional research, only the packaging
[*] One delivery of Dirty Money to Laundering Buildings now lasts for a larger amount of Laundering cycles. Storage capacities of Laundering Buildings now reflect this change, and now they can be overflowed.
[*] Your Starting Region now may have an enemy and arrested buildings on the start. The Player still controls the Smuggling Point of the Region.
[*] Confiscation now lasts 12 days instead of 7.
[*] You can construct a Stadium and a Catherdral in any city now. (But still 1 on the Map)
[*] The time between Mayor Favors has been increased.
[*] Mayor Favor “Lower Terror” now lowers much more Terror, and you can’t get Attention Stars while it happens.
[*] Price for Mayor Favor: Arrest Removal has been increased.
[*] You gain more Loyalty for City Events
[*] Construction of non-city buildings now grants a bit of Loyalty.
[*] Building Demolition with Lieutenant Ability now grants you 90% of the building cost instead of 50%.
[*] The highest Lieutenants' upkeep price during the negotiation phase is now higher.
[*] Conditions of some Deals with Lieutenants have been updated - more products need to be sold.
[/list]

 

[h2]Other updates & changes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Lieutenants now require a certain level of Terror to be recruited. 
[*] An Assassination of your Lieutenant that you ordered will lower the Allegiance of all other Lieutenants in the Cartel.
[*] Silent Assassination ability won’t rise Terror anymore. But it lowers the Allegiance of all Lieutenants.
[*] A lot of minor adjustments and updates to Lieutenant Abilities to bring them up to the current balance changes.
[*] Multiple Tutorial changes to reflect the new update and improve the experience.
[*] 
[/list]
 

[h2]Visual[/h2]

[list]
[*] City Menu now shows all of the Mayor Favors. No need to start a dialogue every time you need a favor! 
[*] New Animation added to Terror Scale to signal the moment it starts lowering.
[*] Tooltips for City and Building War Scales now display the time until the end of the confrontation.
[*] City War Scale has been widened.
[*] Multiple UI reworks for arrested and captured buildings.
[*] Updated Plantation Visuals and Animations
[*] Updated Transport Company Visuals and Animations.
[*] Added Animation for failing the Quest.
[*] Changed the Storage window in the City Menu, making it easier to navigate. 
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Multiple Localization fixes.
[*] Multiple wording fixes.
[*] Multiple Tutorial fixes.
[*] Multiple minor Quest-Events fixes.
[*] Fixed: The game treats Diane and Lyova in the “That Sinking Feeling” campaign as regular lieutenants.  
[*] Fixed: Some Quest-Events didn’t start when pressing their marker.
[*] Fixed: CIA sometimes attacks player buildings that haven’t been used. 
[*] Fixed: Incorrect names of Quest-Events were displayed.
[*] Fixed: Rarely identical Quest-Events could start at the same time. 
[*] Fixed: Incorrect upkeep price for the preinstalled Aerodrome I.
[*] Fixed: Incorrect upgrade time for Aerodrome in Foscani region.
[*] Fixed: Warehouse wasn’t highlighting villages in its radius.
[*] Fixed: incorrect quantity of some products was sold in Border Checkpoints and Seaports.
[*] Fixed: Unlimited number of constructions for Quest-Event granted buildings, now you’re able to build them once.
[*] Fixed: Hotels didn’t have a Turn Off button in UI
[*] The Economics screen now displays money stored in the building during the construction phase.
[*] Removed Boxes from Cargo Filters in Smuggling Points
[*] Fixed: Transport Company capacity bug
[*] Fixed: City Buildings stay turned off when a building was burned during the Concert
[*] Fixed: Completing "Fill or Kill" Quest didn’t update the Money UI.
[*] Hotel and Residence can no longer send money to neutral buildings.
[*] Fixed: Dirty Money for construction doesn’t deliver to Charity Houses
[*] Lieutenants now are able to deliver the correct number of TVs and Consoles in one go.
[*] Lieutenants are no longer able to deliver money to arrested buildings.
[*] Fixed: Researching Workshop I granted “Extended Capacity I” Passive Effect.
[*] You are no longer able to change the upkeep kind for the arrested building.
[*] Fixed: Unable to hire a new Capo after the end of the “That Sinking Feeling” campaign.
[*] Fixed: Players are able to research River Piers II and III before acquiring them through Quests in Story Mode. 
[*] Fixed: City Attacks from US Army don’t stop after saving and loading the game again.  
[*] Fixed: Saving and loading after the US Army attack keep their Attack Circle permanent. 
[*] Fixed: Quest-Event 'Fill Or Kill” granted a reward even after the player fails the Quest.
[*] Fixed: Cesar’s new Ability in the “That Sinking Feeling” campaign is displayed incorrectly. 
[*] Fixed: Cannabis Deal with Carlos Giménez Morales displayed incorrect numbers.
[/list]

[h2]Known bugs[/h2]

[list]
[*] Researcher Ability doesn’t show visual feedback in the Research Center.
[*] Police icons disappear after loading the game in some instances.
[*] Lieutenants with Coordinator Ability sometimes start attacking buildings in their range when performing a different task.
[*] Double attack power is displayed when Lieutenants with Coordinator Ability is moved between buildings in his ability radius.
[*] Manual Icon keeps flashing after you load a Save Game.
[*] Capo selection screen in Sandbox and Survival Modes doesn’t display negative abilities.
[*] Sound effects don’t play in the Transition Screen after Capo’s death.
[*] Lieutenants stay highlighted after using them as a group.
[*] An incorrect tip is displayed in Lieutenant Profile when he doesn’t have enough XP for promotion.
[*] War with US Army Progress Bar is displayed below other UI elements.
[*] Products and Money are not confiscated when an Enemy Gang captures your building.
[*] WASD Navigation doesn’t work in Research Tree Menu.
[*] An incorrect tip is displayed when building a Chemical Factory.
[*] During the “Industrial Action” event Lieutenant upkeep rise is not displayed.
[*] After loading a save progress in "Cash is king" Quest is reset.
[*] Stopping Abilities, Kidnapping, Theft, and Concert may not always work the first time.
[*] Dealer Ability only works for the building the Lieutenant is in.
[*] [Tutorial] Incorrect name of Dryer in the Tutorial Quest is displayed. 
[/list]

[h3]---------------------------------------------

Special thanks to players, who provided feedback and found bugs on our Discord server! 

---------------------------------------------

Keep an eye on our social channels for all the latest news and updates, and be sure to [url=https://discord.gg/Cf674c8b]join the official Cartel Tycoon Discord[/url] to join the community, share your feedback, and chat with the development team.[/h3]

[h3]Happy Holidays, Capos! 

We have released an update for Cartel Tycoon on the Beta Branch. [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36613041/e4e1447ed9cbe5d0cf8f321449d8005d61077de0.png[/img]

[h2]CODE FOR STEAM BETA: [b]CartelTycoonDecember2021[/b][/h2]

[h3]With this update, we wanted to make Terror and Attention Stars less punishing, and introduce balance changes to the game that [b]ultimately give you more choice in your playstyle[/b]. We've also tweaked our Quest-Event system, and now you will see more "positive" Quests that will help you grow your Empires. 

To see all of the changes, scroll down a bit! 

We hope that you enjoy the update and are looking forward to your reactions! [/h3]

[h3][url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1220140/discussions/0/3201495011993037256/]You can leave your feedback for the Beta here... [/url][/h3]

[h3]Or join our Discord to talk to us directly about the Beta Update! [/h3]
[url=https://discord.gg/carteltycoon][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36613041/5078c48aabfb5234678c5d830b089d718379c0dd.png[/img][/url]

[h3]IMPORTANT:
[list]
[*] Your saves will work but we advise starting a new game in Sandbox for the Beta tests! 
[*] Play on the English version of the game, localization is not finished yet! 
[*] We advise playing the Sandbox Mode mostly because Balancing for other Modes is still in progress. 
[/list][/h3]

notes.title: Surprise BETA Update // Devlog 18
notes.content:
[h2]Surprise Beta Balance Update right before the Holidays is here! Check out our newest devlog! [/h2]

[previewyoutube=T5P0_E6l3Ug;full][/previewyoutube]


[h3]Prefer the written word? We've got you covered. 
The full transcript is available below:[/h3]

Ho-ho-hola everyone! Hi! My name is Andrey, and I’m the community manager for Cartel Tycoon. The year is almost over, and we want to bring you yet another update! This time we’ve focused on balancing the game around your feedback, and will also introduce some experimental features! Let’s get right into it. 
 
As we have said in our latest Q&A video (by the way, watch it if you haven’t already) we’re looking at ways to expand, balance, and rework our Terror mechanics. The changes to Terror mechanic is something our players were asking for a while now, and we were looking for a way to introduce the changes while not breaking other systems in place. This update introduces our first steps in this direction! Right now, it’s only beneficial for players to keep Terror at the lowest level possible, and rising Terror brings nothing but trouble. We want to introduce more Terror mechanics that actually encourage players to rise it to higher levels. Let’s talk about balancing and reworking Terror first.
 
First of all, Attention Stars aren’t permanent anymore! We know that will make a lot of people happy! We have reworked the mechanic of all the agencies' attacks, and now they will be happening in waves, like in that mission in the “That Sinking Feeling” campaign. You know the one. Attention Star will light up when the attack wave is about the happen, and after it ends, the Star will deactivate. That means that the attacks themselves will become more persistent - for example, the CIA will follow your lieutenants if you try to move them and will blow up all the buildings that the lieutenant has been in. We’ve also added a new type of attack - Police roadblocks! They will block you out of certain areas and will put more pressure on your production - don’t let your trucks with valuable products move through them! The roadblocks won’t be there forever, of course, you’ll need to wait a couple of days or just… bribe the cops, and they’ll be out of your hair.
 
“But Andrey, the Terror still stays on the same level, and these kinds of changes will only make it harder!” Well, not anymore! Now the Terror will lower by itself! It won’t be fast but if you act like a law-abiding citizen for some time, the Terror level will reflect that! The more Stars you have the slower it lowers, so if you just got to the first Star, you won’t have to worry too much. We’ve also moved Stars a bit on the Terror scale, and for each new Star, you’ll have to gain more Terror than before. Of course, we DID add more ways for you to gain Terror.
 
And now about expanding the Terror mechanic. You’ll be able to sell illegal goods for Terror in Seaports and Checkpoints without the need to package the goods! Less work for you, but more Terror! Some of the lieutenants that are available to hire will also tie with your Terror level. So if you want to hire a certain one for your Cartel, you’ll need to show him your power of intimidation! And your Terror level will also play a crucial role in keeping your lieutenants happy! Some of them enjoy being a part of the peaceful cartel, so if you start any wars, these lieutenants won’t be happy! Of course, some of them joined for the blood and smell of gun powder, so they will enjoy your more… destructive activities. And, there’s more Terror to gain when purchasing legal products from Villages. Let’s talk about that a bit.
 
Villages are getting a massive rework in this update. First of all, we’re introducing Tiers of villages - you’ll be able to upgrade them, and in return, upgraded villages will sell you more types of legal products. We’re also changing the way you’re purchasing from villages: now you can use your Dirty Money to purchase the products, and you’ll be able to set your own prices and face the consequences. If you’re a generous Capo and offer more money for the products, you’ll gain more loyalty. If, however, you want to be feared, and just take whatever you want, be prepared for your Terror level to rise.
 
But this update is called Balance Update, not Terror Update, so let’s talk about general balance changes we’re introducing to the game. We’ve changed our Market mechanic so it won’t affect your early game too much. Prices for Opium and Cannabis won’t be that affected by the Market, but the mid and late-game drugs will require you to experiment, research, and generally keep an eye on the market. 
Another balance change is coming to Quest-Events. Now, “positive” events that are actually helping the player to expand and grow will be happening much more frequently, and we hope that you’ll love this change. 
Also, smuggling points now sell twice as much product! And we’ve also added loading and unloading times to smuggling points so they won’t start sending cargo as soon as you turn them on - you’ll have time to deliver your product and sell it in a bunch, without paying for empty boats and planes! 
We’ve also balanced growing zones around the map, so we’re excited for you to try the regions you haven’t considered before!  There are more mechanics in the works that are scheduled for our next big update, so we’re excited for you to try out this experimental build and leave your feedback on our Discord server!
Oh, and I almost forgot! We have removed locked regions from the Global Unlocks menu so you can enjoy any region you want in a Sandbox game, without the need to conquer them in the Story Mode!
 
There are also, of course, smaller balance changes that will be reflected in the Patch Notes, and bug fixes. And a lot more stuff is in the works for the Special Building update that will be coming after this one. Unique Mayor Quests, anyone? We’ve got a lot more in store, and want to thank everyone who supported the game through the year! But enough about the future, let’s get back to today. You can playtest the Balance Update right now if you join our Discord! We can’t wait to hear your feedback, so what are you waiting for!
 
Are you excited to play the new update of Cartel Tycoon? Write your impressions in the comments, and don’t forget to subscribe here, on YouTube, and on our socials! Share your thoughts about the game we’re building together!


[list]
[*] [url=https://discord.gg/CartelTycoon]Discord[/url]
[*] [url=https://twitter.com/CartelTycoon]Twitter[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.facebook.com/CartelTycoon/]Facebook[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.instagram.com/carteltycoon/]Instagram[/url]
[/list]

notes.title: Quality of Life Update is LIVE
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36613041/b3559c880e582a7072d9c5a5b083f2db9fa7003a.png[/img]

[h2]Major changes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added ability to [b]turn off restriction for the allowed number of buildings[/b] in Sandbox advanced settings! Unlimited hotels, Research Centers and Residences, here we go!
[*] [b]Changed progression to Global Tier II[/b] in the Research Tree.
[*] [b]Multiple Lieutenants Selection[/b]. Added “List of Lieutenants” window with Filters. 
[*] [b]New Hot Keys:[/b] Press and hold L. Shift to turn off buildings sticking to roads in Construction Menu. Use Delete to open the Demolition Menu.
[*] Added additional Dialog for situations when your lieutenant is trapped in an Enemy Region. [b]You can now bring him back[/b] even if you lost the region and the roads are destroyed.
[*] The [b]journalist is now a Quest-Event.[/b]
[*] Added [b]Partial Controller Support[/b] (Xbox 1708) [Experimental]
[*] Upgrading your [b]lieutenants rank is now a Quest-Event.[/b]
[*] [b]Updated the “Statistics” Window[/b] to give more information about sales, earnings, and market prices. The UI has been reworked too.
[*] [b]Music Panel reworked[/b]. You can choose the tracks you want now!
[/list]


[h2]Other updates & changes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Updated UI for Lieutenants transportation Menu.
[*] Added an Additional Research for Tier III Residence – “Additional Transport.”
[*] Added different icons for different types of Quest-Events.
[*] You gain 2x Terror for burning Enemy or Neutral Buildings.
[*] When Saving the game on Pause, it will load on Pause! New Pause animation added! 
[*] Now you can still build buildings that you researched using your lieutenant ability! In Sandbox Mode, you can build them even if you haven’t researched a path for them yet.
[*] Increased the volume of available starting Illegal Money in Sandbox Mode settings (100m $)
[*] New city animations for Abilities “Robbery”, “Kidnapping” and “Concert”.
[*] A new page in the Manual with a controller scheme.
[*] Names of Ports, River Piers, and Checkpoints in the Economics Screen now also contain Region names for easier identification.
[*] Changed biographies of lieutenants with the new “Perform a Concert” ability.
[*] Changed icons for Assassination and Silent Assassination abilities.
[*] Updated Warehouse 3D models.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed: The game no longer crashes when you try to burn the building from the helicopter.
[*] Fixed: Incorrect animations for Capos Helicopter flights.
[*] Research Progress no longer stops at 0 when researching a new building in the Research Center.
[*] Fixed: Pressing Space opened “Building Demolition” window multiple times when demolishing a building
[*] Fixed: Some Quest-Events finished abruptly after loading the Save Game.
[*] Fixed: Charity Events in Church did not count towards the Quest Goal if you gained Loyalty through Villages (Tutorial)
[*] Fixed: Quest with Bribing the Mayor did not count if you captured Rogandes before the quest “Gaining Control I.” 
[*] Fixed: After reloading the save, progress resets in Lieutenant Quests.
[*] The Quest description for “Production Chain I” has been updated to include [Logistics] reflecting the building selection menu changes.
[*] Changed the description for “Have a Feast” Quest-Event. It won’t be confusing anymore! 
[*] Changed the description of the Story Mode in the Main Menu.
[*] When changing a Hot Key for “Pause,” the “Pause” button in the UI will show the Hot Key you’ve chosen.
[*] Transport Company now shows Regions in the “Additional Connections” Tab.
[*] Deleted Text “0 Additional Connections” from the Warehouse menu.
[*] Tips for Quest-Events no longer display beyond the window boundaries.
[*] Fixed: the wrong number was displayed in the dialogue with Diana in “Fair Exchange I” Quest.
[*] Changed Dialogue with Panfilio during “Money Buys Power” Quest to match the Quest description (Survival Mode).
[*] You can no longer perform two concerts in the same city and the same building.
[*] You can no longer perform a concert in a building that hasn’t been built yet.
[*] Updated the description of the “Perform a Concert” ability.
[*] Lieutenant Interface no longer displays above the opened Building List.
[*] Fixed: Freezing Terror Stars doesn’t count as a bribe in a Statistics Menu
[*] Fixed: Incorrect effect descriptions for Residence III
[*] Fixed: Text doesn’t fit the animation after Research and Mayor Quests (depending on the resolution)
[*] Multiple Localization updates and fixes.
[/list]



[h2]Known issues[/h2]
[list]
[*] Several localization issues
[*] On some of the Windows versions (specifically if something has been done with the default Media Player), our animated intro causes the game to crash. The temporary workaround is to turn on “Skip movies” in the settings menu.
[*] Some Nvidia cards cause D3D to crash at start-up (https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/geforce/forums/game-ready-drivers/13/256280/unreal-engine-is-exiting-due-to-d3d-device-being-l/)
[*] The main menu UI is bugged at some laptops - switching from Fullscreen to Windowed or Borderless usually fixes this.
[/list]

[h3]---------------------------------------------

Special thanks to players, who provided feedback and found bugs: KlausK, Silden, Lapperskan, Comrade, SyCo247, Prestige Zed, Slacker

---------------------------------------------

Keep an eye on our social channels for all the latest news and updates, and be sure to [url=https://discord.gg/Cf674c8b]join the official Cartel Tycoon Discord[/url] to join the community, share your feedback, and chat with the development team.[/h3]

notes.title: Research Tree Update is LIVE
notes.content:
[h2]Hola Capos! ːcartel_loveː 
Welcome to the “Research Tree” Update![/h2]

No fancy names this time, just straight to the facts! 

Indeed, the [b]introduction of the Research Tree[/b] which will take place of the old Research Line is the main part of this update.
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/Q2GKRfIMXxKINqnOOS/giphy.gif[/img]

Another big addition to the world of Cartel Tycoon are[b] Quest-Events [/b]- urgent jobs that will be delivered to you by your lieutenants, [b]completing them will affect Loyalty, Allegiance and even Terror![/b]
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/ml5meTZ5OT10Mvq3XR/giphy.gif[/img]

Our lieutenants are also getting a couple of new abilities - they’ll be able to make your research go faster and…. raise your Terror! 

If you want to learn more about these and other, smaller, changes introduced in the “Research Tree” Update, check out our latest Devlog:
[previewyoutube=TDelnTt99nk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Or just read the patch notes below![/h3]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36613041/6f8e73874740d261f04823a3fddce65bb8656612.png[/img]


[h1]ːcartel_loveː Cartel Tycoon V 0.9.1.2198 ːcartel_loveː[/h1]

[h2]Major changes[/h2]
[h3]ːcartel_menaceː Reworked Research Tree. [/h3]it’s no longer a linear process, but a mechanic with meaningful choices that will benefit the growth of your empire! You can also make Additional Upgrades to buildings!
[h3]ːcartel_menaceː Expiring Quest-Events. [/h3]New urgent tasks from your lieutenants, which not only provide more narrative dynamics to the game but also give you new ways to influence Loyalty, Terror, and Allegiance!
[h3]ːcartel_menaceː New Lieutenant Abilities. [/h3]Terror Increase, Transport Company research, Research speed increase, and Loyalty Increase. 
[h3]ːcartel_menaceː Separation of the Story Mode campaigns. [/h3]Now you can immediately select which chapters of Story Mode you want to play - “Tutorial”, “Needs and Fears” or “That sinking feeling”.
[h3]ːcartel_menaceː Market Improvements. [/h3]The price now changes smoothly depending on the player's activity. Market behavior was changed for each Mode individually.

[h2]Other updates & changes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Lieutenants’ initial loyalty is now displayed on the recruitment screen.
[*] Added more helpful textual and visual tips to the tutorial.
[*] Added a loading screen instead of a black background: Now you won’t be so sad.
[*] The Deals with lieutenants now freeze the Market and display a constant price, not a percentage.
[*] Lieutenant’s Allegiance grows after you upgrade his car in Collectors Residence.
[*] We've optimized the game! Optimization has reduced the load on the CPU.
[/list]



[h2]Balance[/h2]
[list]
[*] Workshop progression has been updated - every Workshop upgrade unlocks a new illegal product. 
[*] Warehouse radius expands less with each Warehouse upgrade in the Research Tree.
[*] The Residences radius expands less with each upgrade on the Research Tree. You can expand it more with Additional Upgrades.
[*] The number of connections for Residences has decreased. You can research more with Additional Upgrades. 
[*] Warehouses have 4 cars on Tier III. You can upgrade it to 5 cars with Additional Upgrades.

notes.title: Devlog #16 - Research Tree Update
notes.content:
[h2]Research Tree Update is coming! Take a look at the changes we're bringing to Cartel Tycoon this week! [/h2]

[previewyoutube=TDelnTt99nk;full][/previewyoutube]


[h3]Prefer the written word? We've got you covered. 
The full transcript is available below:[/h3]

Hey! My name is Andrey, and I’m the community manager for Cartel Tycoon. Today I want to tell you about exciting new features coming in the October Update this week![b] Yes, you heard me right - this week, on October 7th! [/b]From Russia With Love update was the biggest we’ve had so far, so we got a lot of feedback from you, so that’s what we’re focusing on primarily in this update. Let’s jump right into it.

First of all, [b]we’re completely reworking the research line, making it an actual upgrade tree[/b], and implementing lots of your suggestions as branches on that tree! The main idea behind this change is to make research less of a linear process and more of a proactive gameplay mechanic that provides you with meaningful choices that will benefit the growth of your empire. [b]You will be able to independently upgrade storage, productivity, and the number of cars the building has![/b] For example, you can focus on making your Aerodromes sell more products at a faster rate! Or add more trucks to your Transport Company! Of course, it will cost you, but it will be worth the price. Upgrades to your existing buildings will open new research paths for you, which will help you shape your empire the way you like it. 


[b]Another big part of the update is the new Quest-Events[/b]. Your lieutenants can bring you important and urgent news at any time, and it’s up to you to decide the outcome. These events have been in the works for a while now. We’re so happy to present you with the first version of our vision. We want our players to experience more narrative challenges and make the world of Cartel Tycoon more lively. [b]These events will offer you more ways to deal with Terror, Loyalty, and Allegiance![/b] Your lieutenants tell you that DEA is snooping around your smuggling points? Listen to them, build or capture a new one, and the Allegiance of all your lieutenants will rise. Dismiss them, and their Allegiance will drop. Are villagers scared of your expanding empire? Buy something from them to show them how generous you can be - all while bringing your Terror down. The choice is always yours.


Another upcoming feature is something you’ve been asking for for a while, [b]new lieutenant abilities![/b] We’re bringing you two new ones. The first one makes your research go faster. With the expansion of our Research Tree, we felt that it was necessary to give you a way to speed it up. 
And the other one, well, rises your Terror. Yes, you heard it right. We want to test out negative abilities with this update. We feel like this change will impact the recruitment process and give way to some exciting scenarios. What do you think about it? Let us know in the comments!


Of course, more goodies are coming with this update. [b]We’ve optimized the games’ performance[/b], added a fancy new loading screen, [b]heard your feedback on the new market feature[/b], and made some changes there - along with a tooltip. Also, we finetuned this feature across the game modes: previous settings distracted players from their main objectives too much! We’ve also made more tips for the Tutorial and made the “Needs and Fears” campaign more beginner-friendly! And now you can choose which Story Mode campaign you want to play! Along with that, [b]we made some adjustments to Deals with lieutenants[/b] - now they’ll give you a fixed price for the product, which won’t be affected by the Market. Of course, [b]bug fixes, minor adjustments will also be in the patch notes.[/b]


Once again, the October Update is coming this week, but starting today, [b]you can join a closed beta test of the upcoming features![/b] Just join our official Discord server for more information. Do it, do it now! 


Don’t forget to follow us on social media and share your thoughts on the October Update in the comments below! 



[list]
[*] [url=https://discord.gg/CartelTycoon]Discord[/url]
[*] [url=https://twitter.com/CartelTycoon]Twitter[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.facebook.com/CartelTycoon/]Facebook[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.instagram.com/carteltycoon/]Instagram[/url]
[/list]

notes.title: From Russia With Love Update Announcement
notes.content:
[h2]Hola Capos! ːcartel_loveː

Today we want to announce our next update - From Russia With Love. It will be hitting the stores on August 23! [/h2]

In this update, we’ve decided to focus on the core gameplay mechanics of Cartel Tycoon. We want our game to be “easy to learn, hard to master,” and not just “hard.” That’s why we’re introducing multiple reworks to our logistics, a full tutorial, and so much more. Of course, there’s also an entirely new campaign for Story Mode - with new characters, hard decisions, multiple endings, and Global Unlocks. Welcome to… 

[h2]From Russia With Love Update[/h2]

[previewyoutube=AxLoJ9nucK8;full][/previewyoutube]

[list]
[*] [b]Complete Story Released!![/b] New characters, storylines, and rewards!
[*] [b]Revamped Logistics[/b]. Flexible filters for cargo, Warehouse and Workshop overhaul, and brand new Transportation Company building
[*] [b]Dynamic Supply and Demand.[/b] The prices are now affected by your actions
[*] [b]River Pier. [/b] A new way to smuggle the goods!
[*] [b]Castle Residence and Collector's Residence.[/b] Unlock them by beating the challenges!
[*] [b]Full Tutorial.[/b] Basics of Cartel Tycoon explained step-by-step.

[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36613041/02dc8d4543889cd4e10a6452bee09b5a60aca50d.png[/img]

ːcartel_menaceː With this update, we’re adding our next chapter to Story Mode of Cartel Tycoon. It’s an entirely [b]new campaign called “That Sinking Feeling.”[/b] Your Capo will meet a Columbian playboy, a Russian gangster, and a “businesswoman” from Miami. You all want the same thing - to achieve your wildest dreams. Can you trust them enough to do it together? That’s for you to decide. Your relationships with these characters will directly impact how this story plays out and what will be waiting for you at the end of the journey. A friend by your side and a region at your feet? A personal helicopter and your own submarine? Or a bullet in the back and an empire in flames.  

ːcartel_menaceː We’ve gathered your feedback and [b]reworked our logistics gameplay loop[/b] to make it much more enjoyable and easier to understand and control. A new building is added to the mix, and we’ve reworked some old ones. More details in this devlog episode (link)

ːcartel_menaceː We’ve added [b]dynamic prices to illegal products[/b], and your actions directly affect them. It means that you’ll have to adapt and modify your empire to bring more profit. We think that this feature makes the gameplay more fun and interactive for the players, even those of you who thought they’ve already figured out the best way to become rich in Cartel Tycoon.

ːcartel_menaceː [b]River Pier is a new type of smuggling point [/b]coming to the game. It’s already on the map, you just need to capture and upgrade it to start using it. Upper tiers of this new building are Global Unlocks from the upcoming campaign in Story Mode!

ːcartel_menaceː [b]Two new types of Residences[/b] are coming to the game. [b]Castle Residence[/b] makes the life of your Capo easier by giving him a helicopter, and [b]Collectors Residence[/b] makes the life of your lieutenants easier - by giving them faster cars. 

ːcartel_menaceː The overwhelming demand for a more[b] detailed step-by-step tutorial[/b] made us realize we have to shift our plans and deliver it right now. We’ll be waiting for your feedback to make it even better.  


Those who closely follow the development process may find that [b]many features mentioned above weren’t on our Roadmap for the August Update[/b]. The reason for that being that we wanted to focus our attention on the core gameplay of Cartel Tycoon and make it as enjoyable and fluid as possible - for new players and veteran Capos alike.

This shift means that [b]we have to postpone the release of the fully-functioning Special Buildings[/b]. We understand that this might frustrate you, but we decided that it is more important to make the core mechanics and approachability of the game better before adding something that doesn’t directly impact the gameplay. We’re working on the buildings, don’t worry, and we’re making them even more “special,” they will be a part of the future updates - just not this one. 

That’s it for today. We hope you enjoyed this peek at the From Russia With Love Update - more changes are coming, and we’ll mention all of them in the upcoming Patch Notes, but today we just wanted to talk about the major things. 

Let us know in the comments if you have more questions! 

Keep an eye on our social channels for all the latest news and updates, and be sure to [url=https://discord.gg/Cf674c8b]join the official Cartel Tycoon Discord[/url] to join the community, share your feedback, and chat with the development team.

notes.title: Devlog #14 - Logistics Overhaul
notes.content:
From Russia With Love Update is coming! Take a look at one of the changes we're very excited about - rework of the logistics gameplay! 

[h3]Devlog #14 - Logistics Overhaul[/h3]
[previewyoutube=G87c_Lf3UMY;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Prefer the written word? We've got you covered. 

The full transcript is available below:[/h3]
Hi! My name is Andrey, and I’m the community manager for Cartel Tycoon. Today we want to tell you about one of the upcoming changes we’re introducing in the August Update - From Russia With Love. We’ve been closely monitoring your feedback and making improvements to the logistics of the game: specifically how your goods are moved, packed, and stored. Today, we’re finally ready to reveal how we’re reworking things. 

You may have noticed that this part of the update wasn’t on our Roadmap. We decided that it’s crucial to make our logistics system more flexible, fun, and much easier to control as soon as possible. After all, it’s one of the core gameplay mechanics of Cartel Tycoon, and we want the game to be enjoyable in all of its aspects. We understood that we need to make adjustments to existing structures and mechanics and introduce some new ones. There’s a couple of innovations that will make your management feel more fluid and give you more control over your operation.

The first building being reworked is the Warehouse. We are removing the ability for your warehouse to work with buildings outside of its radius. We want each building to have a distinct role in the game’s ecosystem to allow for a more localized, intricate logistical design. Therefore, from this update, the warehouse will only import, store and transport goods to and from buildings within its radius. Another essential building that is changing in the update is the Workshop.


Previously, the Workshop was performing two jobs, both packing and transporting produce. From your feedback, it seemed that this was, well, not ideal and a bit confusing, especially to new players. That’s why after this update, Workshops will only be used for packing the product while another new building will handle the transportation...


Introducing the Transportation Company - your one-stop shop for smuggling all your merchandise. This building doesn’t have a radius - instead, you will be able to customize its links to suit your drug empire, ahem… “business network.”  By upgrading the Transportation Company, you will get access to more trucks and more storage space. We believe that the introduction of the Transportation Company will make controlling the logistics part of the gameplay much more precise. And talking about control… 



This update also introduces a much-requested feature, Cargo filters, to our buildings! From this update, you will be able to select which products should be delivered to each facility individually. Don’t want to sell Opium through the aerodrome even when it’s connected to the Transportation Company building moving Opium? Just click on the filter tab and deselect Opium, and it won’t deliver to the Aerodrome anymore! Worried about Grandma looking over your shoulder? Have a Warehouse just for veggies? A Workshop just for TVs with cannabis? Sure thing! 


Each of these changes will serve to rework the gameplay loop entirely, making this update exciting for returning players and new Capos. Thanks to all of you for suggesting these changes on Steam forums and official Discord, and we can’t wait for you to try these changes out for yourself! 



In fact, we’re so excited for you to try the new system, we’ll be holding a playtest of the update in the coming weeks - join our Discord if you don’t want to miss it! Of course, this isn’t the only change that will come in the August Update - we will be sharing more info on our socials and next devlogs! 


Are you excited to play the new update of Cartel Tycoon? Write your impressions in the comments, and don’t forget to subscribe to learn more! 

Follow us on social media and be sure to join the official Cartel Tycoon Discord to stay up to date on all the latest updates and share your thoughts about the game we’re building together!
